##: Upstream only publishes a .rar wrapper containing Joyxoff-<version>.msi (the homepage lists the MSI SHA256). 7zip unpacks the rar, then msiexec installs the MSI (non-portable: the MSI registers the JoyxSvc service used for 'Run on UAC prompts').
description: Xbox controller mapper - emulate keyboard, mouse, media functions and per-process profiles from a gamepad.
notes: Runs from Program Files and installs the JoyxSvc service - install from an elevated (Administrator) terminal.
The MSI is kept in the app directory so 'scoop uninstall joyxoff' can run 'msiexec /x' against it.

script: if ($proc.ExitCode -notin @(0, 1641, 3010)) { abort "msiexec /i failed with exit code $($proc.ExitCode)" }
if ($proc.ExitCode -notin @(0, 1641, 3010)) { abort "msiexec /x failed with exit code $($proc.ExitCode)" }
